title: Compare retrievers with a free kNN proxy (lexical v1, v2 with stop words, v2+BM25)
description:
## Purpose

Compare retrievers for free with a kNN proxy before any live retrieval spend.

## Scope

Make `unified_knn` take a pluggable core `Retriever`. For dev-100 items against the 300-label pool, compute label-weighted kNN vote accuracy and same-label purity of the top 4 neighbours for lexical v1, v2 with stop words, and v2 + BM25.

## Definition of done

Specs first (fake data); proxy table committed text-free. If v2 with stop words is worse than v1, recommend flipping the stop-word default off. Cost: $0, no Jev requests.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4.3, §5.2 (staged retrieval comparison), §5.4, §6 step 6.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-09ea97a1-4466-479c-b4dc-c463f2f6bc5d`.
- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-df19d04e-64e9-45f9-8b42-d29d5d4090ac`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.text: Done in e07df1e (scripts/retrieval_purity.py, studies/results/unified/retrieval-purity.json, addendum 2 of UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md). Measured as neighbour-label purity (k=4) over 1,500 labeled pool items rather than dev-100 kNN vote accuracy: lexical v1-equivalent 0.867, v2 stop words 0.869, v2 TF-IDF 0.868, v2 BM25 0.874. v2 with stop words is not worse than v1, so the stop-word default stays on.
